name: Queens of Our Hearts
source: Queens Of Our Hearts is an interactive dating sim about college life on the west coast as imagined by basement-dwelling neckbeards. As a newcomer to the town of Santa Maria, you will be given the chance to forge relationships with a diverse cast of people, romanceable and not. Mostly romanceable. Let’s be fair, that’s what you’re here for, isn’t it?​
translation: 《心之女王》是一款互动式恋爱模拟游戏，描绘了一群窝在地下室里的死宅脑海中所幻想出的美国西海岸大学生活。作为初来乍到圣玛丽亚镇的新面孔，你将有机会与形形色色的人物建立羁绊——其中有人可攻略，也有人不可攻略。当然绝大多数都能攻略。咱们打开天窗说亮话，你不就是冲着这个来的吗？
